column7: UnlockUser (admin unlock over HTTP/gRPC) and ResumeSecret cleared the restriction first and wrote account.unlocked / secret.resumed afterwards through best-effort writeAuditEvent, so an audit-log error or panic left an unrecorded lift of a login lockout or a suspension (the admin CLI clear-login-lockout already audited first). Both now run the change and the audit row in one withAuditedMutation transaction. Red on main: UnlockUser and ResumeSecret returned nil with the audit write faulted (error and panic) and the restriction cleared; green after: error returned, lockout/suspension kept. Also proved by TestResumeSecret_AuditWriteFault_StaysSuspended and TestUnlockUser_ClearFails_NoUnlockedAuditRow.
